title: Returning from illness, restaurant, and resuming playing
summary: After Springfield he ran a restaurant and bar for two and a half years before playing again.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, we didn't get after Springfield, Illinois. If you got sick and you came back, what happened then?

Well, I come in, I opened up a restaurant and a ball. Uh-oh. Right across the track there. And I stayed around here about two and a half years. You play anything? No, I couldn't play nothing. I had a bad stomach, I couldn't do nothing. I left and went back to New Orleans. And that's where I started playing again. With who? With different fellas.

You were spotting there for a while, right? Yeah, different fellas I was playing with. What about some of the musicians from out of town that you used to play with, you know, that would come down here and maybe be playing with the Lyric or someplace like that? Who would some of them be? I don't know. Well, you must have played with some real famous guys. I don't know if you told me about them.
